Linear's 2025 changelog has 31 entries, and 25 of them contain API or MCP changes. I read each entry page in full, including the "Improvements" and "Fixes" lists. Below are those 25, newest last, then the 6 with nothing relevant.

All links are `https://linear.app/changelog/<slug>`. Entries in the "API" and "MCP server" sections of a changelog are Linear's own labels. Where I list "fix" items, they came from the Fixes list.

| Date | Title | API / MCP part |
|---|---|---|
| Jan 23 | [Pull Request reviews (alpha)](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-01-23-pull-request-reviews) | Added `Customer.integration`, a new `containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent` string comparator, and removed `message` from `OrganizationInviteCreateInput`. Also a fix so guests can no longer install an OAuth app that another user already installed. |
| Feb 13 | [Initiative updates](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-02-13-initiative-updates) | Seven API changes: filters on the paginated `initiatives` query, project dependency `relations` and `inverseRelations`, and webhooks for `Customer` and `CustomerNeed`. Webhook payloads now include the issue identifier and URL. Also invited-user filtering in `UserFilter`, `X-Ratelimit-Endpoint-*` headers, and `projectUpdate.isStale`. |
| Mar 6 | [Sub-teams](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-03-06-sub-teams) | Webhooks for initiatives and initiative updates, upserting customers by tier name, and loading a customer by slug ID. |
| Apr 3 | [Collapsed issue history](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-03-collapsed-issue-history) | Fix only: the `iconUrl` passed when creating an attachment through the API now displays correctly. |
| Apr 10 | [New search](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-10-new-search) | Personal API keys now support granular permissions. Also PKCE for OAuth without a client secret, deprecated `UserUpdateInput.admin` and `active` (use `userSuspend`/`userUnsuspend`), and same-workspace OAuth apps no longer need approval. |
| Apr 16 | [Introducing Pulse](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-16-pulse) | Breaking change: a regular label can no longer be turned into a group label by setting `parentId`. Group labels now need `isGroup: true` at creation. |
| May 1 | [Linear MCP server](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-01-mcp) | Launch of the official remote MCP server at `mcp.linear.app/sse`. It has tools to find, create and update issues, projects and comments. |
| May 15 | [Custom feeds in Pulse](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-15-custom-feeds-in-pulse) | MCP gained priority, due date, assignee and project in issue tools, issue label management, and project date properties. `reactionCreate` now accepts emoji characters. User webhooks now include the profile URL. Users must reauthorize an OAuth app once webhooks are enabled on it. |
| May 20 | [Linear for Agents](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-20-linear-for-agents) | Launch of the Agent API in the developer docs, so agents can be app users that are assigned issues and @mentioned. |
| Jun 5 | [Asks fields and Triage routing](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-06-05-asks-fields-and-triage-routing) | The MCP server supports Cursor 1.0 one-click install with OAuth2. Five API changes: `syncedWith` on Issue and Comment webhooks, `botActor` on comment webhooks, and `createAsUser`/`displayIconUrl` respected in synced Slack threads. Also `User.gitHubUserId`, and `createAsUser` with `actor=app` tokens. |
| Jun 12 | [Project labels](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-06-12-project-labels) | Basic filters for custom Views in the API. Webhooks now fire for comments on project descriptions. The OAuth app details page now shows the "App user". |
| Jul 10 | [Sub-initiatives](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-10-sub-initiatives) | MCP gained project lead, project labels, issue attachments, images in descriptions, find teams by key, cycle filtering, and sub-issue creation. It also fixed My Issues pagination. API: create issues from a team's default template, cycle `isActive`/`isFuture`/`isPast`/`isNext`/`isPrevious`, and stricter content validation. Docs pages can now be copied as Markdown for LLMs, for example by appending `.md`. Fixed missing app-user notification webhooks on unassign. |
| Jul 17 | [Email intake for Linear Asks](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-17-email-intake-for-asks) | MCP now includes `Issue.delegate` and tells the model when responses span multiple pages. API: `IssueHistory.fromDelegate`/`toDelegate`, two new webhook source IPs (Linear recommends signature verification instead), and faster webhook delivery for consecutive changes. |
| Jul 24 | [Dashboards](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-24-dashboards) | MCP: pagination on `list_issues`, replying to comment threads, and no more unnecessary truncation of text. |
| Jul 30 | [Agent Interaction Guidelines and SDK](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-30-agent-interaction-guidelines-and-sdk) | Developer preview of the Agent Interaction SDK, covering agent delegation, agent session status and agent activity. MCP `list_cycles` returns more detail. Fixed some webhooks not being delivered. |
| Aug 14 | [Product Intelligence (Technology Preview)](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-08-14-product-intelligence-technology-preview) | MCP: query and modify issues by name instead of UUID, `list_users` `query` filter, pagination on `list_issue_labels`, and tool annotations. API: `issueDelete` returns the deleted issue, and `AppUserNotification` webhooks return `oauthClientId` as the client ID. OAuth gained `initiative:*` and `customer:*` scopes for `actor=app`. The API settings page shows when a key was last used. |
| Aug 21 | [Cursor background agents](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-08-21-cursor-agent) | `issueAddLabel` and `issueRemoveLabel` now return the issue. |
| Sep 4 | [Salesforce integration](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-04-salesforce) | `userEmail` is an optional input on `issueSubscribe`/`issueUnsubscribe`. Unauthenticated API requests now get 401 instead of 400. `issueAddLabel`/`issueRemoveLabel` return the issue (fix). OAuth app avatar changes propagate to app users. |
| Sep 18 | [New to Product Intelligence: Auto-apply triage suggestions](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-19-auto-apply-triage-suggestions) | OAuth apps move to 24-hour access tokens with refresh tokens. New apps get them from Oct 1, 2025, and existing apps must migrate by Apr 1, 2026. Added the `client_credentials` grant. MCP accepts an existing API key or OAuth token and can query and set project state and members. API: new `semanticSearch` query, removed the `Issue.delegate`→`assignee` mirroring shim, and `issue:create` tokens can use `issueSubscribe`/`issueUnsubscribe`. App-user developer tokens now let you choose scopes. The URL slug says 09-19. |
| Oct 2 | [Issue discussion summaries](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-02-issue-discussion-summaries) | MCP `get_user` accepts "me" or "current_user". | Oct 16 | [Mobile app redesign](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-16-mobile-app-redesign) | OAuth apps can subscribe to webhooks for user authorize and revoke events. |
| Oct 23 | [Linear agent for Slack](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-10-23-linear-agent-for-slack) | MCP fix: filtering issue labels by team name no longer fails argument validation. |
| Nov 20 | [Form templates](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-11-20-form-templates) | Figma Make connector exposing all MCP server tools. Fixed `includeSubTeams` on `updates` for custom views with no team. Fixed webhooks not firing for private teams, and stripped attachments in agent session webhook payloads. |
| Dec 4 | [OpenAI Codex agent](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-12-04-openai-codex-agent) | `issueUpdate` allowed with the `issues:create` scope, `Issue.stateHistory` exposes all workflow state changes, and projects can be created from a template via API. `ProjectLabel` webhook updates added. Same webhook and `includeSubTeams` fixes as Nov 20. |
